# Divisors of n ± 1 on standard curves, and the Cheon gain a q-SDH leak would buy

Trial division to 2^22, then Pollard rho with a bounded budget; `unsplit` cofactors are
excluded, so each `largest d ≤ q` is a lower bound.  Gain is √d for the p−1 case (needs
`[α^d]G`, d | n−1) and √d/… for the p+1 case (needs 2d inputs, d | n+1, cost √(n/d)+d).
